issues.title: Ingest Washington County’s 2026 budget
issues.detail: The county’s 2026 budget as filed with the state (artransparency.gov, May 2026), turned into a money trail with a page cite on every amount.

stamped.revealed: $129,707,474 across 26 funds. The largest: General Fund ($57,369,449), Jail Operations & Maintenance ($29,744,325), Road Fund ($16,738,515). Every total marked complete adds to its parts to the cent; where the county’s own pages disagree, the page keeps the printed number and an open question below.
